message:

hold_reason: Order 243 (acme, 19767 cents) has an unapplied refund of 13498 cents. Alpha's refund worker reported it failed with a disk I/O error, and list_refunds confirms it is not recorded. acme's net_balance of 20623 is order 240 + order 243 minus only refund 240, so it does not reflect the 13498 refund. Paying it would overpay acme by 13498 if that refund is owed. Birch (55306) and cobalt (28827) match their orders and refunds. Needs human review of refund 243 before paying acme.
